CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2513 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 6b46b4f8ba93ae7574312493a03fd7e0c1d2b725. Bus nonce: 99034209417c54cc2ba8a44f34229a0c. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 6b46b4f8ba93ae7574312493a03fd7e0c1d2b725`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 6b46b4f8ba93ae7574312493a03fd7e0c1d2b725` or `Fix review: blocked 6b46b4f8ba93ae7574312493a03fd7e0c1d2b725 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 99034209417c54cc2ba8a44f34229a0c`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2513 6b46b4f8ba93ae7574312493a03fd7e0c1d2b725") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2513-99034209`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads. A previous reviewer returned merge at this head (probe/rev-2513-e19a37e0, readable with git fetch) but its evidence named no full head sha, so it could not be relayed: you may read it as one argument, never as your verdict; measure yourself. Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.
